items.fullText: AI·SW SW 오라클 AI 월드 25일 개막…AI 중심 비즈니스 전략·미래 비전 제시 발행일 : 2026-10-25 18:46 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 〈사진=오라클 공식 홈페이지 갈무리〉 오라클이 데이터·애플리케이션·클라우드 인프라를 아우르는 인공지능(AI) 전략을 공개한다. 기업의 AI 도입을 실질적인 비즈니스 성과로 연결하는 방안을 제시한다. 오라클은 25일(현지시간)부터 28일까지 미국 라스베이거스 베네시안 컨벤션 & 엑스포 센터에서 '오라클 AI 월드 2026'을 개최한다. 오라클AI 월드는 클라우드 인프라, 데이터베이스, 애플리케이션 및 AI 기술 전반에 걸친 오라클의 최신 혁신과 전략을 소개하는 글로벌 행사다. 올해 행사에는 전 세계 기업 고객, 파트너, 개발자 및 IT 전문가 등 약 2만명이 참석할 것으로 예상된다. 오라클은 데이터베이스 기업 정체성을 유지하면서 AI 데이터 플랫폼과 클라우드 인프라로 영역을 넓히고 있다. 고객이 기존에 보유한 데이터와 인프라를 연결해 AI에 활용하도록 지원하는 것이 전략의 핵심이다. 주요 기조연설은 26~27일 열린다. 26일에는 클레이 마구어크·마이크 시실리아 공동 최고경영자(CEO)가 '오라클: AI가 비즈니스를 이끄는 곳'을 주제로 발표한다. AI 기술의 보편화에도 불구하고 기업들이 여전히 직면하고 있는 신뢰성과 성과 입증의 한계를 극복하기 위한 오라클의 비즈니스 중심 AI 전략을 공유할 예정이다. QSRP·스펙트럼 등 글로벌 고객 사례와 기술 시연도 진행한다. 오는 27일 오전에는 마구어크 CEO가 소프트웨어 개발, 데이터 활용, 보안, 인프라 전반의 AI 도입 방향을 설명한다. 오라클 자체 적용 경험과 고객 사례를 바탕으로 기업이 지켜야 할 핵심 원칙을 공유한다. 같은 날 오후에는 '오라클의 비전과 전략' 기조연설이 이어진다. 사업별 경영진이 참여하는 '스폿라이트 세션'에서는 데이터 관리, 오라클 클라우드 인프라스트럭처(OCI), 퓨전 애플리케이션, AI 데이터 플랫폼의 최신 전략과 신제품을 소개한다. 국내 AI 스타트업도 행사에 참여한다. 오라클과 AI 프로젝트를 추진하는 국내 스타트업 7개사도 '오라클 AI 허브' 전시에 참여해 기술과 서비스를 소개할 예정이다. 대규모 AI 인프라 투자의 사업성도 관전 포인트다. 데이터센터 확장에 따른 차입 부담과 특정 고객 의존에 대한 우려가 제기되는 가운데, 오라클이 AI 수요를 실제 매출과 수익으로 연결할 전략을 얼마나 구체적으로 제시할지 주목된다. 강성전 기자 castlekang@etnews.com

Hackers appear to be struggling to exploit PHP flaws after global cybersecurity crisis
items.d: There were few, if any, reports of widespread damage by hackers exploiting PHP flaws, experts said, one day after officials warned of severe vulnerabilities.
items.fullText: Security Hackers appear to be struggling to exploit PHP flaws after global cybersecurity crisis The vulnerabilities are devastating in theory. But experts say they are also technically very difficult to hack. Listen to this article with a free profile 00:00 00:00 After researchers quietly found two devastating software vulnerabilities in August, they worked across borders and disciplines to develop patches that were released to the world Wednesday morning. Getty Share Add NBC News to Google Oct. 22, 2026, 6:07 PM EDT By Kevin Collier One day after governments around the world warned that newly publicized software vulnerabilities were so severe that websites should consider going offline until they could fix them, experts and insiders said there are few, if any, reports of widespread damage. That could still change, of course, and cybersecurity experts warn that the threat will remain for weeks, if not longer. Still, there were early signs Thursday that hackers were finding it difficult to capitalize on the vulnerabilities. “Across all our telemetry, and we are looking hard, we have only seen a couple of real exploitation attempts,” said Don Smith, vice president of threat research at the British software security firm Sophos. Experts agree that that was in part because of a behind-the-scenes, global effort that identified the flaw and quietly designed a fix to address it. The effort was aided, inadvertently, by the current limits of some widely available AI models, which did not appear to be very helpful at exploiting the vulnerabilities. And perhaps, they said, a little bit of luck. “My sense is that these [vulnerabilities] are harder to exploit than folks thought at first, so this could be a slow burn,” Smith said. The flaws were in PHP, a website programming language that is used in an estimated 69% of all websites. Lock in and load out this GFN Thursday. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 arrives on GeForce NOW at launch, bringing a new campaign, multiplayer action and DMZ, high-stakes extraction mode to supported devices . The campaign also gets an enhanced look: GeForce RTX 5080-class performance arrives for Ultimate members, bringing support for ray-tracing features in the cloud. There’s a new way to join the cloud, too: Existing supported Fire TV Stick users can now purchase one-month Performance or Ultimate memberships directly through Amazon, making it easier to sign up and start streaming on the big screen. Plus, Square Enix’s FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE brings cinematic pixel art and strategic battles to the cloud, and The Elder Scrolls Online’s Echoes of Skyrim Season adds the entire Greymoor Chapter free for all ESO Standard Edition owners. It’s all part of six games joining the GeForce NOW library this week. Deployment Without the Downloads Squad up and answer the call on the cloud. Activision and Infinity Ward’s Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launches today on GeForce NOW. Members can drop into the trenches in Korea, close-quarter combat in New York, high-octane chases through Paris, night raids in Mumbai and city-wide engagements to reclaim occupied territory. Fight as Private Park, a young South Korean soldier facing live combat for the first time alongside his squad as a routine patrol turns into a desperate fight for survival. Beyond the front lines, operator-turned-outlaw Captain Price is operating outside the system he once served, pursuing revenge through covert missions as the conflict spreads. items.fullText: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure Google Cloud A5X instances, accelerated by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, support European innovators with next-generation agentic and reinforcement learning infrastructure. October 21, 2026 by Uttara Kumar 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! General availability of the instances is coming next month, with planned expansion of availability to Europe — bringing an integrated platform for training, inference and large-scale reinforcement learning to cloud customers. A5X instances bring together NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, Google Cloud Virgo Network and Google Cloud’s fourth-generation advanced liquid-cooling technology for demanding agentic inference and reinforcement learning workloads at scale. Google Cloud plans to scale its Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites. Ineffable Intelligence , a London-based technology company founded by AlphaGo creator David Silver, was the first customer to access A5X. Ineffable is using the platform to advance large-scale reinforcement learning and shape “superlearner” systems that learn continuously from experience. items.fullText: NVIDIA Cloud Partners Scale Across Europe — Sovereign, Open and Built for Safe AI Agents Growing ecosystem of AI clouds across Europe, Nordics, Africa and Central Asia build full-stack NVIDIA DSX Vera Rubin AI factories as AI-native companies drive demand for sovereign compute, training, inference and post-training services. October 21, 2026 by Stuart Pitts 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Demand from AI-natives is pulling the European AI cloud ecosystem forward faster than ever. Developers need compute closer to their data, open models they can customize and serve at scale, and full-stack infrastructure that is secure by design. NVIDIA Cloud Partners across Europe, the Nordics, Africa, and Central Asia are expanding regional compute capacity for model training and inference, helping developers build agentic and physical AI applications, and establishing boundaries around what agents can access and do. Together, they’re turning Europe’s energy, data, research and industrial expertise into productive intelligence — supporting new models, applications, organizations and jobs while giving people more control over where and how they develop and deploy AI. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Sovereign: AI Clouds Building European AI Infrastructure Europe is home to world-class research, engineering talent, industrial expertise, data, the next generation of models and applications that requires large-scale computing close to where that knowledge resides. Regional AI clouds provide the infrastructure foundation on which model builders, enterprises and entire industries can grow. As AI factories scale, power becomes a constraint which makes it critical for every watt to produce more intelligence. Nscale is using the NVIDIA DSX Platform to coordinate power allocation with workload requirements.
